Metadata.title: AMS Airport Ride — Schiphol Taxi with Fixed Price
Metadata.description: Book your Schiphol taxi with a fixed price from €35. Also for regular taxi rides within Amsterdam and between Dutch cities. Pay easily after your ride.

TopBar.freeCancellation: Free cancellation up to 3 hours in advance

Hero.label2: Flight number? We account for delays
Hero.title: Taxi to Schiphol.
Hero.subtitle: Your price is fixed before you book — even at night, on weekends, or in traffic. Add your flight number and we'll take any delay into account. Booking takes 30 seconds.
Hero.supportingText: Enter your route and see your price right away — before you book.
Hero.compactTrustLine: No surcharges · Luggage included · Free cancellation up to 3 hours ahead

FlightMonitor.label: How our flight monitoring works — example

Why.title: Your airport transfer, without the hassle.
Why.intro: From your front door to Schiphol and back again. We keep the booking simple, the price clear and the journey comfortable.
Why.item1Body: See your fixed fare before you book. No taximeter surprises during your journey.
Why.item2Body: Enter your trip details, confirm your ride and you're ready to go.
Why.item3Body: We focus on rides to and from Schiphol and destinations around Amsterdam.

PopularRoute.title: Popular route
PopularRoute.disclaimer: Your exact price is calculated based on your pickup address and destination.

TwoColumnBanner.amsterdamBody: From Amsterdam West to the city centre and every other district. Calculate your ride price based on distance and travel time.
TwoColumnBanner.schipholBody: After a long journey, you want to get to your destination quickly and comfortably. Your driver will contact you as soon as you clear customs.

AmsterdamTaxi.title: Need a taxi in Amsterdam?
AmsterdamTaxi.body: Schiphol isn't required: you can book AMS Airport Ride just as easily for a regular taxi ride within Amsterdam itself.
AmsterdamTaxi.example6: or any other address in Amsterdam
AmsterdamTaxi.outro: Enter your pickup and destination to see your price right away — based on distance and travel time.

PaymentTrust.title: Pay when you arrive
